title: Hamiltonian Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The Hamiltonian must be correctly written as H = (1/2m)(P^2) - (q/mc)(A.P) - (gq/2mc)(s.B).

title: Momentum Equation
description: Important Criteria: The equation for the time derivative of momentum must be derived correctly as dP_i/dt = (q/mc)(partial_i A_j) P_j.

title: Angular Momentum Equation
description: Important Criteria: The equation for the time derivative of angular momentum must be derived correctly as ds_i/dt = -(gq/2mc)(B x s)_i.

title: Helicity Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The value of g for constant helicity must be identified as g = 1.

title: Particle g Values
description: Essential Criteria: The correct values of g for the specified particles must be provided: e: -2.0, p: 5.6, n: -3.8, pi: 0.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes in the equations of motion or the Hamiltonian.

title: Neglecting Terms
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that the neglect of A^2 and higher order terms is justified and correctly applied.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Check that all terms in the Hamiltonian and equations of motion have consistent units.
